title: Sum a list
description: Return the sum of all integers in a list. Empty lists return 0.
hints: Check whether the loop processes every element.
Compare the returned sum with the expected sum. Which elements might be missing?
The stop value of range() is excluded. Examine how you calculate it.
explanation: The original loop excludes the last element. Iterating over the values includes every element and handles an empty list.

title: Count even numbers
description: Count the even integers in a list, including zero and negative even numbers.
hints: Try a list with only even numbers and compare the count.
Think about the remainder an even number leaves when divided by two.
explanation: The condition selected odd numbers. A zero remainder identifies even integers, including zero and negative even integers.

title: Find maximum
description: Return the largest integer in a nonempty list. Empty lists are outside the contract.
hints: Consider lists containing only negative numbers.
Can the initial candidate be larger than every input value?
Choose an initial candidate that belongs to the nonempty input.
explanation: Starting at zero fails for all-negative inputs. Starting with a member of the nonempty list gives a valid candidate.

title: Count vowels
description: Count a, e, i, o, u case-insensitively in a string. Empty strings return 0.
hints: Does the function return before examining the entire string?
Indentation determines whether return belongs to the loop body.
explanation: The original return ends the function during its first iteration. Returning after the loop processes all characters and returns zero for an empty string.

title: Factorial
description: Return n! for a nonnegative integer n. factorial(0) is 1.
hints: Examine the starting value of the running product.
What happens whenever a number is multiplied by zero?
The multiplicative identity should also give the correct answer when the loop has no iterations.
explanation: A product starts at the multiplicative identity, one. This also yields factorial(0)=1 when the loop is empty.
